caption_L1: Here a is a area diagram called Mobility in selected cities between March 3 , 2020 and December 7 , 2020 , compared with movement prior to the coronavirus outbreak. caption_L2L3: Mobility plummets quickly in March 2020. The lowest mobility was in late April. After late April/May, mobility rose very gradually overall up until December.
